brief.zh: 运行可配对和不可配对两组输入，对比报出的索引是怎样靠拢的。
brief.en: Run one matching and one nonmatching input, then compare how the indexes move together.

examples.source:
work = scan()
readings = work["values"]
target = work["target"]
left = 0
right = len(readings) - 1
found = False
while left < right and not found:
    say(str(left) + ", " + str(right))
    total = readings[left] + readings[right]
    if total == target:
        found = True
    elif total < target:
        left += 1
    else:
        right -= 1
submit(found)
